reason: A project-continuity plugin that guides long-running work through user-approved Goals, Milestones, session checkpoints, and consent-gated recovery using bundled Skills.

summaries.zh: 通过用户批准的目标、里程碑和回合检查点，为长期项目提供持续执行、状态恢复和交接支持。
summaries.en: Supports long-running project execution with user-approved goals, milestones, durable turn checkpoints, and consent-gated recovery.

capabilities: Persists user-approved project Goal and active Milestone associations
Maintains durable Turn checkpoints and handoff state across sessions
Provides consent-gated recovery and native Goal resume behavior
Loads bundled project-management Skills on demand
Runs a package preparation build during approved Git source installation
